business_problem: With Google Cloud data and AI services, Customedia and Custom Analytics are aggregating data from client advertising platforms into a single source of truth and providing powerful data-driven insights to optimize advertising spend.
solution_summary: "The fundamental shift we've unlocked is a more robust, reliable solution that enables clients to have greater trust in what they're seeing and a profoundly greater ability to interrogate what they see," says Richard Warwick, head of digital at Customedia. "Our customers want to get under the hood to understand their data and generate their own reports and dashboards, and services such as Looker enable that." Meanwhile, Custom Analytics uses Gemini LLMs for powerful analysis of data from a range of platforms and to provide the resulting insights in plain language. solution_components.role: Provides the reasoning or generation layer used for classification, orchestration, content generation, or analysis.

solution_components.name: BigQuery
solution_components.role: Serves as the governed analytics and storage layer for high-volume operational data, features, and reporting.

solution_components.name: Looker
solution_components.role: Serves dashboards, governed metrics, or natural-language analytics on top of the shared data model.

solution_components.name: Cloud Storage
solution_components.role: Stores source documents, media, or raw files that feed the automated workflow.

solution_components.name: Cloud Run
solution_components.role: Runs serverless application services and APIs with automatic scaling for bursty workloads.

business_outcome: With Google Cloud, the organizations moved to a powerful, flexible, and integrated data stack and reduced data ingestion failures by 90%. Reliable access to data builds customer confidence and trust in the organizations, and positions them to step up the sale of existing and enhanced products to customers.
metrics: "We chose Gemini 3 Flash for its speed and cost-effectiveness and Gemini 3 Pro for its deep and rich analytics capabilities," says Santiago Moscatelli, Head of Analytics at Custom Analytics.
architecture_clues: In addition, the robust security and data controls within Google Cloud enable Customedia and Custom Analytics to meet customer requirements to manage access to certain types of data and retain it in certain locations for governance and compliance.
